Upstream v26.7.1 release notes."
components.summary: Patch release. The operand image bumps include k8s-driver-manager, which changes the driver DaemonSet, so with driver.upgradePolicy.autoUpgrade the operator cycles the driver pod node by node and evicts GPU workloads on each node in turn; the driver version itself is unchanged. The computedomains CRD now matches the DRA driver's, but AICR's Helm and Flux deployments leave an installed copy unchanged (gpu-operator is not ownsCRDs, and the chart's CRD upgrade hook skips computedomains), so a cluster first installed with v26.7.0 keeps the copy that requires spec.numNodes.
